quota_unit: Kaggle accelerator-session wall seconds; T4x2 quota is charged by session runtime, not multiplied by visible GPUs

training.parallelism: Both arms for each seed run concurrently, one process per T4; five seed pairs remain sequential.

common_scoring.purpose: FEATFLOW QoI scoring, fixed held-out diagnostics, metadata export

unallocated_safety_reserve.use: absorbs startup overhead, checkpoint/score variance, or an optional smoke; never hyperparameter search or seed replacement

arithmetic: 300 setup + 6000 paired training wall + 600 scoring + 300 reserve = 7200 quota seconds
device_seconds_arithmetic: 12000 training + 600 scoring = 12600 active-device allocation seconds (3.5 T4-device-hours); T4x2 second device is idle during scoring
notes: The five paired seeds fit arithmetically only if both arm processes actually run concurrently on separate T4s.
The 2-hour quota includes an external 300-second setup allowance; script execution stops by 6900 seconds.
An optional 240-second transport smoke must fit inside the 300-second safety reserve and is not added after the full campaign.
The code requires two visible T4 devices and uses a separate child process per device; there is no CPU fallback.
No CPU reference solve is proposed. FEATFLOW remains the official QoI anchor, and the FEM field remains absent.
GPU runtime per seed and the ability of both architectures to finish at this cap are unmeasured.
Kaggle quota is measured as session runtime for T4x2; device-seconds count the T4 assigned to each process.
